environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed behind CloudFront distribution with the following configuration: (1) CloudFront Function on viewer-request event that inspects POST requests and validates that the `Origin` header matches the distribution's CNAME (transfers.internal.corp.example.com) — requests with mismatched or missing Origin receive 403; (2) Response headers policy 'Managed-SecurityHeaders' attached which sets `Set-Cookie` attributes including `SameSite=Strict; Secure; HttpOnly` on all Set-Cookie response headers via CloudFront response headers policy override; (3) The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips the `Cookie` header from cross-origin preflight responses, and the behavior's cache policy uses `CachingDisabled` with origin request policy `AllViewerExceptHostHeader`. The CloudFront Function source performs string comparison: if (!origin || !origin.endsWith('.internal.corp.example.com')) return 403. Note: SRI on the page scripts prevents injection of modified client-side code that could bypass the Origin-based check by proxying requests.
